party_a.evidence_quote: HSBC BANK, USA, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION (“Party A”)

governing_law.evidence_quote: ISDA Agreements Subject to New York Law Only

threshold.value: Infinity for Party A, subject to reduction to zero upon certain ratings trigger conditions; Not Applicable for Party B.
threshold.evidence_quote: “Threshold” means with respect to Party A: Infinity; provided that for (a) so long as the Moody’s First Ratings Trigger Requirements apply and either (i) the Moody’s First Ratings Trigger Requirements have applied since this Annex was executed or (ii) at least 30 Local Business Days have elapsed since the last time the Moody’s First Ratings Trigger Requirements did not apply, the Threshold shall be zero; or (b) so long as (i) an S&P Approved Ratings Downgrade has occurred and has been continuing for at least 10 Local Business Days or since this Credit Support Annex was executed or (ii) an S&P Required Ratings Downgrade has occurred and has been continuing, the Threshold shall be zero.

minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote: “Minimum Transfer Amount” means with respect to Party A, $50,000.

rounding.value: Delivery Amount rounded up and Return Amount rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of $10,000.00.
rounding.evidence_quote: The Delivery Amount will be rounded up and the Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of $10,000.00, respectively.

valuation_percentage.value: Varies by eligible collateral type, remaining maturity, and applicable rating agency trigger level; lowest applicable percentage applies if rated by multiple rating agencies.
valuation_percentage.evidence_quote: The Valuation Percentage shall equal the percentage specified under such Rating Agency’s name above. If Party A is rated by more than one Rating Agency specified above, the Valuation Percentage shall equal the lowest of the applicable percentages specified above.
